objective: Test whether frozen training-only opening-hard seed selection improves early survival without reducing later survival.

arms.uniform: Uniform sampling with replacement from the frozen shared training-only pool.
arms.opening_priority: 50% uniform floor plus 50% sampling from the frozen opening-hard stratum of the same pool.

priority_source: Historical completed full-game training episodes only; freeze labels before either arm. No current or future evaluation seed contributes to pool or labels.

native_seed_profile.native_metadata: Retain seed_mode.mode=evaluation and seed.evaluation=true exactly as native returns. Python adapter separately authenticates role=training_only through pool manifest membership.
native_seed_profile.rollouts: All PPO transitions are newly collected from the current policy in normal-start full-game episodes. No historical transitions or behavior cloning.

design.matched_rng_vectors: Six-key vectors paired across arms; proposal artifact separately recorded.
design.checkpoint: Accepted parent324, restore model and Adam, then LR 3e-5.
design.reward: score delta + 0.01 per alive frame - 5 on true death; unchanged.

sampling.strata: 256 opening-hard and 256 easier comparison seeds, selected by the parent deterministic stratified hash over training-only control completions.
sampling.selection_probability: Each pool seed has uniform-arm probability 1/N. Hard-seed treatment has 0.5/N + 0.5/H for hard seeds and 0.5/N for other seeds; relative hard-seed multiplier 1.5, below proposed cap 4.
sampling.stream: Deterministic SHA-256 derivation from study, replica, env master seed, slot and episode. Treatment uniform component shares exact draws with paired control; hard component uses separate domain label.
sampling.fault_policy: No retries, replacement seeds, or dynamic stream edits. Repeated pool visits are part of the registered sampling policy.

evaluation.terminal: Update60 only; sample categorical actions; normal starts; cap18000; no cutoff.
evaluation.cohort: Fresh parent-reserved D4 shared across arms; D5 reserved separately for confirmation. Current D300 is consumed.
evaluation.interpretation: Descriptive three-pair pilot. Full-game assignment does not guarantee late-age exposure; earlier death can lower later-age frames. No checkpoint promotion or automatic selection.
